calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --workspace 2>/dev/null || mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --worktree
mu task claim t1 -w eval --for w1

git -C "$PWD" cherry-pick $(git -C $(mu workspace path w1 -w eval 2>/dev/null || echo $MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/w1) rev-parse HEAD)
